liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments were stable at {{cash_like@FY2025}}, a change of {{cash_like.change@FY2025}}, and cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, so cash liquidity covers the near-term maturities only thinly, and in FY2024 borrowings due within two years were {{borrowings_due_2y@FY2024}}.

Free cash flow after lease payments was {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}} in FY2024, or {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}} of debt, showing that lease payments absorbed the cash that free cash flow leaves out.

Customer prepayments rose, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}} and advance ticket cover up by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, so a larger part of the cash is customers' prepayments.
